proposal.reason: Main change is host one-sided RMA (Put/Signal/Wait) executed via CE/DMA paths, including CE-side signal/wait ordering and per-context CE state; enqueue is additionally needed because new RMA task types, planner queues, batching, and launch routing are introduced; device-api is additionally needed because public PCCL APIs and symmetric-window/LSA validation semantics are extended for these operations.
